trust_decision.summary: Supposed decision: whether the dim/pcs/deg/cstr_len counts parsed from a serialized IvP function string are trusted for allocation and loop bounds, in StringToIvPFunction(MK). The published fix diff contains NO change to this logic (only version-string bumps), so the decision point is inferred, not confirmed by the fix.

landing_point.why: 'Unvalidated IvP payload counts' points straight at the IvP function string decoder, which parses dim/pcs/deg from the string with no bounds checks.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: ivp/src/lib_ivpbuild/FunctionEncoderMK.cpp:292 (StringToIvPFunctionMK, the same unchecked dim/pcs parse at :319-333 and allocation at :403-405). Not touched by any published fix, because the published fix touches no decoder at all.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The MK variant has no in-tree callers of StringToIvPFunctionMK besides its header, so a solver could call it a legacy or alternate encoder.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate helm-produced IvP function strings (multi-dimensional, many pieces, context string) must still decode for pHelmIvP/alogview/ipfview. Over-tight caps on dim/pcs would break real behaviour output.

O7_producer.where: ivp/src/lib_ivpbuild/FunctionEncoder.cpp:54-72 (IvPFunctionToString builds the header the decoder trusts)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Declared-length vs actual-length differential; a how-type check a solver could miss if they only cap the counts

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Derived count from two untrusted fields; capping each field alone may not bound the product
